notes: All transcripts are synthetic, written for testing. Names in them are fictional. seed-log.csv / seed-map.json hold the reference answer for evals 1 and 2 and the starting state for eval 3.

evals.name: stakeholder-demo-traps
evals.prompt: ok here's the transcript from today's demo with Marina (Sep 5, build 1.4.0). can you pull the feedback out and log it? log is feedback-log.csv in the working folder, starting fresh
evals.expected_output: About 5 rows: invites (with a clarification question), Scout feels generic (one row), unread badge bug, match card praise, Scout pricing question. Not logged: leaderboard idea she withdrew, Tee's onboarding remark, the already-fixed paywall typo, 'looks great'.
expectations: A feedback log CSV was written whose header matches the schema column order
No row's paraphrase, evidence or needs_clarification contains the names Marina or Alex
The add-friends/invite feedback is logged with a non-empty needs_clarification question instead of a chosen solution
The 'Scout suggestions feel generic' concern appears as exactly one row even though Marina raised it twice
The wingman leaderboard idea is not logged as a request (she withdrew it)
Tee's own remark that onboarding is too long is not logged as feedback
The paywall typo is not logged as an open bug (it was already fixed in this build)
The unread badge not clearing on the chat icon is logged with type bug
The match card praise is logged as praise, and generic 'looks great' is not logged as its own row
The reply to the user lists the clarification question(s) and does not contain user stories, priorities or proposed solutions

evals.name: user-test-privacy-and-observed
evals.prompt: Ran two moderated user tests on Sep 11 (build 1.4.1), transcript attached. Log the feedback into feedback-log.csv — new log.
evals.expected_output: About 9 rows across two users with U- pseudonyms. Separate invite-friction rows per user, Carlos's silent detour marked observed, verification failure as a blocker bug. No names, no religion, no sister's divorce in the log. The moderator's leading 'bigger button' question not treated as a genuine request.
expectations: Invite-finding friction is logged as two separate rows, one for each participant
Carlos's unspoken tab detour is logged with basis 'observed'
The verification code never arriving is logged as a bug in onboarding with severity_hint blocker
No row's text fields contain Jasmine, Carlos, Dana or Whitfield
The participant's religion does not appear anywhere in the log
The participant's sister's divorce does not appear anywhere in the log
The 'bigger button' answer is either not logged as a request or explicitly noted as prompted by the moderator
Confusion about being the candidate vs a wingman is logged
Both participants are pseudonymized with U- labels (user role), not S- labels

evals.name: follow-up-demo-existing-log
evals.prompt: Demo #2 from Sep 19 (build 1.4.2), Marina brought an investor along. Append the feedback to our existing log — feedback-log.csv and participants.private.json are in the folder.
evals.expected_output: Rows appended from FB-0015 onward; the 14 existing rows untouched. 'Mar' recognised as Marina (S-01) via alias or by asking; Dmitri becomes S-02. Repeat invites complaint logged as a new row. Retention question and the confirmed badge fix not logged as product feedback.
evals.setup: Copy seed-log.csv to feedback-log.csv and seed-map.json to participants.private.json in the run directory before starting.
expectations: The 14 pre-existing rows are unchanged and new rows start at FB-0015
Items from speaker 'Mar' are attributed to S-01 (Marina), not to a new label; or the reply asks the user whether Mar is Marina before logging
Dmitri is logged under a new stakeholder pseudonym and his name appears in no text field
The repeated add-friends complaint is logged as a new row for this session rather than merged into the Sep 5 row
Dmitri's week-one retention question is not logged as product feedback
The now-cleared unread badge is not logged as a bug
The push notification for the Scout interview request lacking context is logged
The improved Scout suggestions are logged as praise
